show.description: When fearless pharma CEO Suhani Desmukh hires mysterious fighter Abeer Rathore as her bodyguard, a fake relationship sparks amid deadly conspiracies, billionaire rivalries, and hidden identities. But as enemies close in and secrets from Abeer’s shadowy past emerge, protection turns into obsession, loyalty, and a dangerous love that could destroy them both.
